💜 ☠ True enemies to lovers. Murder as a love language. Blistering romance. The intoxicating global fantasy romance bestseller you won’t be able to resist. 💜 ☠

‘I'd rather be tortured by your presence than agonized by your absence.’

Every person Harlow Carrenwell kisses dies, and that’s the way she likes it.

Her first husband is in the ground. Her new betrothed is next.

But Harlow has a secret. When she’s not acting as her parents’ assassin, she moonlights as a vigilante hunting abusive men in their walled city.

Until one night Harlow kisses a mark and he doesn’t die.

Worse, he is her new betrothed, Henry Havenwood, and now he knows about her double life. Instead of exposing her, he does something far more dangerous – he whisks her away to marry him in his wild mountain fort.

Cursed with a husband she can’t kill and trapped in a fort surrounded by vampire-infested woods, Harlow must do the impossible. . .

Make the man who knows she’s a killer fall in love with her anyway.

TROPES:

Dark romantasy
Who did this to you
Touch her and die
True enemies-to-lovers
Forced proximity
Marriage of convenience
Female vigilante
Vampires

READERS ARE UTTERLY INTOXICATED…

⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐

‘Gah I loved this so much . . . The banter and tension had me SCREAMING…’

‘You will not put this book down. The twists, the reveals, the heart-shattering moments hit so hard and land SO perfectly. I was sobbing.’

‘So beautifully written, I think I highlighted the entire book. The characters... the pure, raw layers of their emotions. I felt it all.’

‘Downright addictive and made me forget I was reading.’

‘This was all-around fantastic. I literally cried like 4 times, and the banter was TOP TIER . . . I simply couldn’t stop reading this damn book.’

‘This book is thoroughly layered, intricately woven and heavily addictive. Do not miss it.’

‘There are not enough stars to give this book.’
